videos.overview: Bonnie isn’t quite ready to give up on Elton, LJ starts his training, and Nicolette has to face reality.

videos.title: Episode 234
videos.overview: Uys and Nicolette are head over heels, Thalia goes for a job interview, and Naomi isn’t all that impressed with Elise’s project - and Annetjie notices.

videos.title: Episode 235
videos.overview: Uys is determined to find out the source of Nicolette’s symptoms. Bonnie hears that Binneland’s management wants to help her make a "dream" come true, and Thalia is finally honest with LJ.

videos.title: Episode 236
videos.overview: Elise’s dreams are crushed, the ghost of LJ’s mom still haunts him, and an email gives Uys new hope. Tracy feels betrayed by Thalia.

videos.title: Episode 237
videos.overview: Uys interrogates Nicolette to test a possible diagnosis, Joe gets suspicious when LJ starts making mistakes at work, and Tracy is stunned by Elise’s wisdom.

videos.title: Episode 238
videos.overview: Nicolette writes her exam, but receives bad news. Things between Thalia and LJ are finally over, and Tertius returns to Pretoria – and Tracy is caught off guard.

videos.title: Episode 239
videos.overview: LJ makes a radical decision in order to get his life back on track, Nicolette’s career is in jeopardy, and the vibe between Tertius and Tracy is strained.

videos.title: Episode 240
videos.overview: LJ is leaving sooner than Ella had hoped for, Tracy uses Conrad as an excuse, and Nicolette has had enough.

videos.title: Episode 241
videos.overview: Nicolette goes into theatre again, despite everyone’s warnings. It looks like Tracy is considering the big move, and Thalia is still struggling to find a job.

videos.title: Episode 242
videos.overview: Nicolette begins to think that one's dreams can change. Naomi is surprised and worried about her friends' hasty future plans, and Thalia receives an upsetting voice message.

videos.title: Episode 243
videos.overview: Joe and Uys are reprimanded, and the tension in Ongevalle escalates. Thalia is thrown into the deep end once again, and Tracy is worried that things are moving too fast.

videos.title: Episode 244
videos.overview: Tertius informs Joe of his decision and Binneland Stereo starts spreading the news. Thalia tries to cope with a demanding doctor, and the new locum arrives – leaving Ella frustrated.

videos.title: Episode 245
videos.overview: Thalia gets a slap on the wrist, a dangerous patient seeks treatment and Ella and Katryn have to help him, and Uys thinks Nicolette needs a break. Thalia considers Louis’ offer.

videos.title: Episode 246
videos.overview: Tracy and Tertius still don’t see eye-to-eye about Tonik, Nicolette dropping out of the surgery program gives her new clarity, and Ella doesn’t trust Tertius’ motives. Katryn’s true identity is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 247
videos.overview: Uys and Nicolette arrive in Buffels Bay, Katryn moves in with Naomi and Louis, and Tracy has a new suggestion for Tertius.

videos.title: Episode 248
videos.overview: Nicolette and Uys get to know each other better, and Tracy lures Tertius into a trap. Gossip causes Katryn to come to a shocking realisation.

videos.title: Episode 249
videos.overview: Uys and Nicolette are enjoying their holiday, until guests arrive unexpectedly. Katryn watches Ella like a hawk, and Tracy vents to Naomi.

videos.title: Episode 250
videos.overview: Nicolette agrees that their guests can stay over, Katryn admits to Johan that she knows who Ella is, and Tracy makes a decision about Tonik and Australia.

videos.title: Episode 251
videos.overview: Conrad’s threat shocks both Tracy and Tertius, Nicolette is forced to lie, and Katryn regrets her impulsive decision.

videos.title: Episode 252
videos.overview: Tertius and Joe’s wild night at Doepa has serious consequences. Ella puts more pressure on Johan for the manager position at Ongevalle, and is shocked when Johan reveals Katryn’s true identity.

videos.title: Episode 253
videos.overview: Tertius is on his way, one of Uys and Nicolette’s guests sees something she shouldn’t have, and Ella says the wrong thing to someone.

videos.title: Episode 254
videos.overview: Despite her personal happiness, Nicolette manages to hurt someone very close to her. Ella firmly believes a colleague is plotting her downfall, and Joe is excited about a possible new opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 255
videos.overview: Annetjie has questions for Tracy and Tracy gets the wrong impression, Ella tries to convince Johan that Katryn has sinister motives, and Hannah hears that Petro is helping Uys with a gift.

videos.title: Episode 256
videos.overview: Tracy finds companionship with Conrad, someone reveals a catastrophic misunderstanding to Uys, and Katryn takes Ella’s side.

videos.title: Episode 257
videos.overview: Katryn questions Ella’s version of events, Annetjie’s attempt to help Tracy fails miserably, and Uys considers asking Nicolette to marry him.

videos.title: Episode 258
videos.overview: Thalia is worried that things are becoming too much for Tracy, Katryn receives a call from Canada, and Nicolette tries to be a mediator.

videos.title: Episode 259
videos.overview: Henry reprimands Katryn about her accusations about Ella, Tracy feels lonely with Tertius gone and Conrad wants to come back as soon as possible.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Thalia is faced with a new challenge at work, Katryn finds evidence of Ella’s infidelity, and Tracy and Tertius clash over Leah. Binneland’s shareholders make a decision about the co-head position at Ongevalle.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Dewald refuses to give up, Uys notices something that doesn’t sit right with him, and Joe is thrown in at the deep end.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Thalia tries to hide the fact that Binneland’s new doctor fascinates her, Tracy finally puts her foot down regarding her and Leah, and Hannah expects something from Nicolette that is almost impossible.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ella feels guilty about using Tracy, but Johan convinces her that it isn’t wrong. Dewald meets Liv and is surprised when she doesn’t fall for his charm, and Uys realises how difficult it is for Nicolette to be out of the operating room.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Conrad presents an idea to Binneland’s board, but Johan has his reservations. Nicolette realises just how much she has missed being in the operating room, and Dewald feels that Henry doesn’t trust him.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ella and Johan try to delay Conrad’s project, and Hannah feels jealous of Uys and Nicolette’s relationship. Nicolette’s fear of the operating room is diffused and she receives another job offer.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Conrad tries to ease some of Tracy’s pressure, but she isn’t happy about it. Nicolette is torn over the new job offer, and Johan becomes more determined to stop Conrad’s project before it gets underway.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: At gets an unexpected visitor on the farm, Liv finds something interesting in Dewald’s locker, and Uys decides to talk to Nicolette about her job offer.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Tracy and Conrad visit At’s farm, where he tells Conrad that he feels uneasy about the project. Nicolette suggests that Uys go away with her. It seems that Dewald and Liv are getting along better, but she has other plans.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Nicolette makes a decision about her future. Dewald gets a taste of his own medicine, and Joe and Ella declare a tentative ceasefire. At warns Conrad that he is playing with fire.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Hannah is heartbroken when she learns about Nicolette’s plans, Dewald succeeds in sabotaging Liv, and At confronts Conrad about his friendship with Tracy.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Both Thalia and Liv are furious with Dewald and demand that he fix what he has broken, Johan visits At on the farm, and Binneland says goodbye (for now) to an aspiring young doctor.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: At and Conrad are at loggerheads over Johan, Hannah wants to cheer up Uys, and Dewald finally apologizes.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Johan Matthys’ true identity is revealed to the board, and Ella pretends she didn’t know. Dewald and Liv call a truce - albeit a temporary one - and Thalia is stunned when she learns about Dewald’s admission of guilt.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Dewald makes a big decision about his mentor, and Thalia knows of someone who is romantically interested in Bonnie. Tracy doesn’t want to tell Tertius about Conrad.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Bonnie and a patient’s friendship grows and he tells her about a website where he shared his life story. Johan shares something with Tertius that leaves Tracy speechless.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Both Conrad and Johan try to persuade Binneland’s board members before a meeting, Bonnie sends a message on a chat site, and Henry makes a decision about Dewald’s future.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: While everything seems to go wrong for Conrad, At places more trust in Johan. Henry has a change of heart, and Bonnie struggles to feel enthusiastic about a romantic date.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: There seems to be no end to the big decisions Tracy is making, and Bonnie is unaware that the friend she's chatting to online is starting to develop feelings for her.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Uys starts to panic when he can’t get hold of Nicolette, Thalia opens the door to an unexpected visitor, and everyone tries to understand why Hannah is in a bad mood.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Louis and Naomi grow increasingly worried about Hannah’s behavior, and Hannah wishes she could speak to Nicolette, but no one can reach her.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Le Roux is admitted to Binneland and gets an unexpected diagnosis. Hannah finally reveals to Naomi what has been bothering her, and Bonnie tells “Surferdude” about her possible romantic date with a friend.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Kristin wants to get in touch with Le Roux’s biological mother, Naomi fears that Hannah might run away again, and Thalia warns Bonnie not to play with men’s feelings.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Luke struggles to come to terms with the fact that Bonnie is possibly dating someone. Tensions rise when Le Roux’s biological mother meets his adoptive mother face to face, and Hannah finally tells Naomi the truth.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Kristin finally realises the true severity of Le Roux’s condition, Bonnie reads Luke’s fortune, Jackie’s phone rings, and Joe gets the surprise of a lifetime.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Joe makes a potentially life-changing decision, while a phone call leaves Louis and Naomi in a difficult position. Meanwhile, although unintentional, Bonnie finds herself playing with a nice guy’s feelings.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: It’s Annetjie’s big day, Naomi makes contact with Jackie, and Thalia is confronted with a strange request.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Bonnie is determined to meet “Surferdude” in person, Joe sets out to confirm whether he is related to someone, and Naomi is forced to come clean to Louis after taking matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Naomi tries to placate Hannah’s fears, Thalia discovers the true identity of “Surferdude”, and Joe receives the results of his DNA test.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Joe accuses Anya, convinced that a certain Binneland patient is another man’s child. Jess receives big news, and Bonnie witnesses Luke’s vulnerable side.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: “Surferdude” almost reveals his true identity, and Bonnie gets suspicious. Jackie wants to start over and has Naomi’s support, and Le Roux’s identity leads to shock and confusion.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Joe feels that too much pressure is being placed on Jess, while Bonnie feels betrayed. Louis is willing to give Jackie another chance - but only under certain conditions.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: In his desperation, Joe takes a dangerous step, Naomi’s kindness ultimately softens Louis, and Bonnie is determined to cut a friend out of her life.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Joe searches for his mother, believing that desperate times call for dangerous measures. Louis tries to hide the presence of a new employee, and Bonnie is confused about her emotions.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Thalia confronts Luke about Bonnie, Petro grows concerned about Joe and the demands of a dangerous man, and Louis opens up to Uys.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Joe finds a way to contact his mother, Bonnie decides to check in on a patient, and after an accident at Mimi’s, Louis begins to develop a newfound respect for Jackie.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Joe is in turmoil as he struggles to come to terms with his identity - Petro wants to help but feels powerless. Luke is head over heels in love, Hannah wants to see her mother, and Uys meets Jackie for the first time.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Ella receives a second threatening email, Tracy begins to wonder whether she might be missing out on something, Brian defends Jackie, and Petro supports Joe.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Ella is haunted by someone who seems to know a great deal about her past. Louis must correct a major mistake he has made, and the challenges Tracy faces are not becoming any easier.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Tertius wants to save Tracy from financial ruin, Jackie struggles with the fact that she is no longer a part of Hannah’s life, and Frieda du Pont meets Henry Louw.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Tracy struggles to secure funding for Tonik’s upgrades, Bonnie feels increasingly unwell at work but Ella refuses to let her go home, and Frieda gives a doctor an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Ella is in turmoil over a threat, Jackie reappears, and Uys learns that more patients have developed wound infections at Binneland.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Frieda confronts a doctor at Binneland, and Henry witnesses the encounter. Tracy is excited to work alongside a possible new partner, while Petro feels neglected by Joe.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Petro is frustrated with her relationship with Joe, Louis helps Tracy with Tonik, and Ella, Johan, and Henry underestimate an infection problem that is on the verge of spiralling out of control.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Tracy officially gets a new business partner, while Thalia’s plans with Dewald go awry. The net around Ella tightens, and she is forced to make a few drastic decisions.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Ella desperately tries to convince Binneland’s management of her innocence, Tracy is annoyed with Louis and his suggestions to save money, and Thalia is confused about Dewald’s feelings towards her.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Ongevalle is shut down for a deep clean, Louis drops a bold new business proposal for Tonik, rattling Tracy, and Frieda arrives – ready to take full revenge.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Bonnie encourages Thalia to ask Dewald out, Frieda shows up at Henry’s rooms, and Tracy has a serious talk with Louis.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Just as Henry and Ella seem to be working on their issues, Joe receives shocking news. Louis starts conducting market research on Tonik, and Tracy is livid. Meanwhile, Petro gives Joe’s Refentse ticket to Dewald.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Tracy and Tertius finally reach a peaceful balance in their co-parenting relationship. Thalia is upset when it becomes clear that Dewald has feelings for someone else, and the truth about a doctor’s identity leads to a dramatic turn of events. Refentse performs in Doepa!

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: A once-happy relationship between two colleagues is left in tatters after a betrayal. Thalia meddles in other people’s affairs, and while Tracy continues to face challenges at work, her personal life gradually begins to improve.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Ella makes an almost impossible request to Johan. Tracy struggles to sign the divorce settlement agreement, and Bonnie reveals Thalia’s closely guarded secret to Petro.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Tracy receives an unpleasant surprise that catches her off guard. Disillusioned by recent events, Thalia blames a friend, while yet another Binneland doctor considers resigning.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Johan is faced with deciding the outcome of a disciplinary hearing, Tracy continues to struggle with the reality of her divorce, and tension between Dewald and Thalia make for a highly uncomfortable situation.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Ella and Dewald clash over the treatment of a patient, Tracy suddenly feels like a new person, and Johan unexpectedly hears from someone from his past.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Petro kicks off with a leadership programme, and Joe feels lonely. Tertius and Leah reconnect, and Katryn returns to Pretoria – but she wants no one other than Dewald to know about it.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Johan is sceptical about the cause of a car accident. A secret Naomi is keeping on behalf of a friend prevents her from being honest. Petro grows increasingly concerned when Joe starts behaving out of character.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Johan believes Katryn’s life is in danger, Uys convinces Tertius to stay with Tracy while he is in Pretoria, and Joe is determined to find his biological mother.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Joe is desperate to uncover his real identity, and Petro makes a breakthrough. Things become noticeably more comfortable between Tertius and Tracy, and Johan is on edge when Katryn has to undergo surgery. Meanwhile, a dangerous former Binnelander makes her appearance.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Tertius devises a plan with Tracy, while Johan is once again reminded that he will do anything to protect his daughter. In his search for the truth, Joe reaches yet another dead end.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Annetjie offers to help Petro with a presentation, and Tracy is consumed by guilt over Tertius and Leah. Ella advises Johan to be honest with Katryn.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Katryn receives a visitor, At makes Tertius aware of everything he is giving up in South Africa, and Joe discovers potential new clues about his biological mother.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Katryn gets a private nurse, but the nurse conceals her true identity. Petro is anxious about her presentation, and Joe offers little support. Meanwhile, Tertius, Tracy and Leah find themselves together in At’s farmhouse.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Johan becomes suspicious of Katryn’s seemingly innocent and helpful nurse. The peace and quiet on At’s farm does everyone good, and Rian receives a very unexpected and unwelcome guest.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Tertius and Tracy make a bet, Rian’s guest withholds important information from him, and Joe accidently overhears a conversation between Uys and Petro, leaving him furious.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Tertius shocks Tracy with a very big question, and Uys confronts Joe for driving a wedge between him and Petro. Johan becomes concerned when Katryn starts sleeping excessively, and finally puts two and two together. Meanwhile, a dangerous trap is set, putting someone’s life in danger.
